limitations: No real email delivery, deployed staging, payment or external provider integrations tested.
Core record saves use authenticated browser fetch calls; account lifecycle, project creation, invitations, page navigation, markups and download use UI controls.
Native PDF plugin root cause remains unconfirmed; primary preview now uses verified PDF.js canvas rendering instead.
New resend network/rate-limit UI branches use explicit synthetic browser responses; server rate limits and invalid/expired tokens also covered by security suite.
